lines.zh: 钻石碎屑从关节间掉落
lines.en: Diamond dust falls from its joints.
It drags its chain across the ore.
It runs a hand over its crystal plates.
It winds the broken chain back around its wrist.
Its crystals glow blue in the dark.
It stands still as a vein of ore.
Iron eyes flash, player in sight.

lines.zh: 晶体的反光扫过你的脸
lines.en: The gleam of its crystals sweeps your face.
It weighs whether you carry diamonds.

lines.zh: 它盯上你的镐，眼睛发亮
lines.en: It fixes on your pickaxe, eyes brightening.
It peers out from behind a heap of ore.

lines.zh: 它侧头听你包里的叮当
lines.en: It tilts its head toward the clink in your pack.

lines.zh: 它的眼光落在你的镐尖
lines.en: Its eye-light settles on your pick’s tip.
It marks where you stand and looks away no more.
It stares at you like unclaimed ore.

lines.zh: 晶体崩了一块，它疼得发抖
lines.en: A crystal chips off and it shakes with pain.

lines.zh: 发出诱人的光芒，引诱你靠近。
你听到地面下传来的声音，是他的呼吸。
lines.en: You hear a breath beneath the ground.

lines.zh: 它的声音在黑暗中回荡，充满诱惑。
lines.en: Its voice echoes in the darkness, enticingly.

lines.zh: 你发现它盯着你的矿石。
lines.en: You see it staring at your ore.

lines.zh: 它似乎在等待最佳的狩猎时机。
lines.en: It seems to be waiting for the perfect hunting opportunity.

lines.zh: 靠近它的矿洞入口，你感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: Approaching its cave entrance, a chill runs down your spine.

lines.zh: 它的目光锐利，似乎能看透一切。
lines.en: Its gaze is sharp, as if it can see through everything.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在夜空中回荡，令人不安。
lines.en: Its call echoes through the night, unsettling.

lines.zh: 它的存在仿佛在警告你远离。
lines.en: Its presence seems to warn you to stay away.

lines.zh: 它的声音中带着一种难以抗拒的吸引力。
lines.en: Its voice holds an irresistible allure.

lines.zh: 你一不小心撞上了它，几乎丧命。
lines.en: You bump into it, nearly losing your life.

lines.zh: 你撞上它坚硬的躯体，感到剧痛。
lines.en: You collide with its hard body, feeling intense pain.

lines.zh: 它的身体如此庞大，让你无法避免碰撞。
lines.en: Its massive body makes collision inevitable.

lines.zh: 你和它在洞穴中碰撞，四处飞散。
lines.en: You collide with it in the cave, scattering in all directions.

lines.zh: 它的触碰让你感到刺痛。
你和它在黑暗中擦身而过，几乎相撞。
lines.en: You nearly collide with it in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的动作快如闪电，你只能勉强避开。
lines.en: Its movements are lightning fast, barely avoiding it.

lines.zh: 你试图避开它，却撞上它的尾巴。
lines.en: You try to avoid it, but collide with its tail.

lines.zh: 它突然出现，迫使你改变方向。
lines.en: It suddenly appears, forcing you to change direction.

lines.zh: 你试图绕过它，却意外撞上了它的领地。
lines.en: You try to bypass it, but accidentally collide with its territory.

lines.zh: 它开始发出求偶的低鸣声。
lines.en: It begins to make low mating calls.

lines.zh: 它用低沉的声音吸引配偶。
lines.en: It uses a deep sound to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在空气中回荡。
lines.en: Its mating call echoes through the air.

lines.zh: 它用特殊的声音吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It uses a unique sound to attract a partner.
It makes a soft mating whisper.

lines.zh: 它试图与潜在的配偶建立联系。
lines.en: It tries to establish contact with a potential mate.

lines.zh: 它的声音中充满了对伴侣的渴望。
lines.en: Its voice is filled with desire for a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出的求偶声吸引了另一只同类。
lines.en: Its mating call attracts another of its kind.

lines.zh: 它在求偶中表现出异常的温顺。
lines.en: It displays an unusual docility in mating.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在夜晚格外响亮。
lines.en: Its mating call is particularly loud at night.

lines.zh: 钻石的光一闪，我就弯下腰。
lines.en: A diamond glint, and I stoop to grab it.
Watch out, this is my territory!

lines.zh: 你矿灯的光，照进了我的矿层。
lines.en: Your headlamp shines into my ore layer.
The diamonds are in my pocket. Don't try.

lines.zh: 你身上的晶味暴露了你
lines.en: The crystal scent on you gives you away.
It locks onto your mining lamp.
You have broken into its ore layer.
The chain snaps taut and it gives chase.
It takes you for a walking ore vein.
It decides: you are its property.
The diamond sits heavy in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把铁链在拳上绕了两圈。
lines.en: I wrap the chain twice around my fist.

lines.zh: 恐惧将是你最后的伴侣！
lines.en: Fear will be your last companion!
It reels the chain in, link by link.

lines.zh: 它用矿石堵死你的退路
lines.en: It seals your retreat with chunks of ore.
It whirls the broken chain overhead.

lines.zh: 晶体在它拳上聚成尖刺
lines.en: Crystals gather into spikes on its fist.
It is in no hurry; ore does not escape.
It strikes an echo from the stone.
It has the distance measured, half a step short.
It lowers its body; the chain draws tight.

lines.zh: 链条抽在地上，碎石乱跳。
lines.en: The chain lashes the ground; gravel jumps.

lines.zh: 晶体从我的指节长出来。
lines.en: Crystals grow out of my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我用锁链把你的脚踝缠住。
lines.en: I coil the chain around your ankle.
The chain lashes across your back.
A crystal fist shatters your shield.
It hauls you toward itself by the chain.
It pins you against the ore vein.

lines.zh: 铁拳落下，地面塌了一角
lines.en: The iron fist falls and a corner of the floor gives way.
The scent of prey grows stronger!
Diamond Dave is here — clear out.

lines.zh: 矿洞深处，晶体亮了一下
lines.en: Deep in the mine, a crystal flickers.
Chain noise comes from behind the rock.
It tears free of a diamond vein.

lines.zh: 废弃矿道尽头有了脚步
lines.en: Footsteps start at the end of the abandoned shaft.
Its blue light reaches the cave wall first.
It climbs to this level, dragging a broken chain.
Ore clatters down; it stands up.

lines.zh: 有人在矿里唤它的名字
lines.en: Someone in the mine calls its name.
